## What changes?

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and any relevant issue.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. For UI changes, include sanitized
before/after screenshots when helpful. For parser changes, use synthetic
fixtures rather than real Codex session data.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The scope is focused, and related documentation is updated.
- [ ] Relevant existing checks pass, or any missing validation is explained.
- [ ] No credentials, personal paths, prompts, or private usage data are included.
- [ ] Changes to consent, networking, or local data access are described above, if applicable.
